title: Swap email provider: Postmark -> Resend
tech: Node/TypeScript backend, plain fetch (no SDK) -- matches PostmarkEmailSender's existing zero-dependency approach
keyConstraints: This is a like-for-like swap behind the existing EmailSender interface (backend/src/services/emailSender.ts) -- emailQueueService.ts, emailWorker.ts, and emailTemplates.ts depend only on that interface and EmailMessage's shape ({to, subject, body}), never on Postmark specifically, so none of those three files should need to change. Reason for the swap: Postmark's own signup form rejects gmail/yahoo/other public-domain email addresses ('please use your work email on a private domain'), which blocks local development entirely -- confirmed live during setup, not a hypothetical. Resend's free tier requires no custom domain to test and has no such signup restriction. Remove PostmarkEmailSender entirely rather than leaving it as unused dead code -- it will not be reachable from anywhere once server.ts is updated, and keeping an unused, never-exercised HTTP-calling class around is a maintenance liability (could silently rot and mislead a future reader about which provider is actually active). Resend's send endpoint is POST https://api.resend.com/emails, Authorization: Bearer <RESEND_API_KEY>, JSON body { from, to, subject, text } -- use `text`, not `html`, since emailTemplates.ts's existing renderEmail output is deliberately plain text (see its own comment: 'Emails are plain text, not HTML, so there's no markup to escape').
description: The email-sending integration needs a provider swap before any further real-email testing is possible. EmailSender is already a clean interface with exactly one implementation (PostmarkEmailSender, ~25 lines, a single fetch() call) -- ResendEmailSender should be the same shape: same constructor signature style (apiKey, fromAddress), same send(message) method, same error-handling discipline (on a non-ok response, throw an Error including the provider's status and response body text, but never the API key). Update config/email.ts to read RESEND_API_KEY instead of POSTMARK_API_TOKEN (EMAIL_FROM_ADDRESS is unchanged, just now used as Resend's 'from' field). Update server.ts to construct ResendEmailSender. Update backend/.env.example's POSTMARK_API_TOKEN line to RESEND_API_KEY with an accurate comment. Also correct a pre-existing gap in agents/context_template.md while touching this area: its 'External APIs' line currently reads 'none currently' under Security-Sensitive Areas, which was already inaccurate before this task (it never accounted for Postmark either) -- update it to name Resend as the one external API this system calls (outbound email sending), so future task Architects have an accurate picture.
acceptanceCriteria: ResendEmailSender implements the existing EmailSender interface, POSTs to https://api.resend.com/emails with an Authorization: Bearer <RESEND_API_KEY> header and body { from, to, subject, text } mapping EmailMessage's to/subject/body fields (text, not html)

On a non-ok response, throws an Error including the provider's status code and response body text, matching PostmarkEmailSender's existing error shape -- the API key itself is never included in any thrown error or logged output
PostmarkEmailSender is removed entirely, not left as unused dead code
config/email.ts's loadEmailConfig() (or an equivalent renamed function/shape) reads RESEND_API_KEY and EMAIL_FROM_ADDRESS via requireEnv, same fail-fast-on-boot behavior as before
server.ts constructs ResendEmailSender instead of PostmarkEmailSender when starting the email worker
backend/.env.example: POSTMARK_API_TOKEN is replaced with RESEND_API_KEY, with an updated comment; EMAIL_FROM_ADDRESS's comment references Resend instead of Postmark
agents/context_template.md's 'External APIs' line under Security-Sensitive Areas is corrected to name Resend as the one external API in use (outbound email), rather than 'none currently'

New unit test(s) for ResendEmailSender (no test existed for PostmarkEmailSender either) -- mock fetch, assert the request URL/headers/body shape on success, and assert the error path throws with status+detail and never includes the API key in the thrown message
npm test, npm run build, npm run lint, and tsc --noEmit all pass in backend/
securityConsiderations: Same discipline as the Postmark implementation it replaces: never log or include RESEND_API_KEY in thrown errors or console output. RESEND_API_KEY is a secret with the same handling as the token it replaces -- present in backend/.env (gitignored, local-only) and backend/.env.example (placeholder only). No new attack surface: this replaces one already-reviewed outbound HTTP call to a trusted third-party email API with another; the EmailSender interface boundary means emailWorker.ts's retry/backoff/outbox/claim logic (already reviewed in task 005) is completely unaffected by this swap.
